verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a BugSnag AI feature that drafts code fixes or opens pull requests against a user's repo. The official SmartBear MCP server and the Data Access API only expose BugSnag data to external agents, which makes them developer building blocks. Jira issue sync and stack-trace code links are adjacent features, not AI-generated fix PRs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI can draft a code fix for an error and open a pull request against my repo for human review
